cmd.list.desc: List Jira issues matching JQL query.
cmd.list.usage:
Usage: jira list [JQL] [--all|-A] [--due <EXPR>] [--status <STATUS>] [--assignee|-a <USER>] [-o table|json|md] [--json] [--md]
List Jira issues. (e.g. jira list --all --due <=today)
cmd.list.flag_all: Query across all projects (clears default project_key filter)
cmd.list.flag_due: Due date filter (today, <=today, tomorrow, <=tomorrow, week, YYYY-MM-DD, <=YYYY-MM-DD)
cmd.list.flag_status: Status filter (open, done, all, or specific status name)
cmd.list.flag_assignee: Assignee filter (me, none, or user email/id)
cmd.get.desc: Get detailed information, description, subtasks, and comments of an issue.
cmd.get.usage:
Usage: jira get <KEY> [-o table|json|md] [--json] [--md]
Get details of a Jira issue. (e.g. jira get KAN-1 --md)
cmd.get.err_missing_key: Usage: jira get <KEY> [-o table|json|md] [--json] [--md] (e.g. jira get KAN-1 --md)
cmd.create.flag_desc: Issue description (Markdown formatted, converted to ADF)
cmd.create.flag_parent: Parent issue key (required for Subtask or Epic linking)
cmd.create.flag_force_labels: Allow non-standard labels outside the catalog
cmd.create.flag_allow_empty_desc: Allow creating issue without description body
cmd.create.usage:
Usage: jira create <SUMMARY> -d <DESCRIPTION> [options]
Create a new Jira issue.

Options:
cmd.create.err_summary_required: Issue summary is required. (Usage: jira create <SUMMARY> -d <DESC> [options])
cmd.create.err_summary_min_length: Issue summary must be at least 5 characters excluding whitespace. (Given: '%s')
cmd.create.err_summary_flag_prefix:
Issue summary cannot start with flag prefix ('-'): '%s'
To pass it as a literal, place it after '--' delimiter. (e.g. jira create -- '-d Fix bug' -d 'details')
cmd.create.err_desc_required:
Description (-d, --desc) is required.
💡 Detailed description is required for team collaboration and clear task tracking.
   (To create a stub ticket without description, use '--allow-empty-desc')
cmd.create.err_invalid_due_date: Invalid due date format (--due): '%s' (expected format: YYYY-MM-DD)
cmd.create.err_label_validation:
❌ Label validation error: %v
   Undefined labels: %s

💡 View standard labels catalog using 'jira labels'.
   (To allow non-standard labels, pass --force-labels)
cmd.edit.desc: Update fields of an existing Jira issue.
cmd.edit.flag_parent: Parent issue / epic key (or 'none' to detach)
cmd.edit.usage:
Usage: jira edit <KEY> [options]
Update an existing Jira issue.

Options:
cmd.edit.err_no_fields_to_update: Specify at least one field to update. (e.g. jira edit KAN-9 --due 2026-09-01 -l 'FDE,AI' --parent KAN-17)
cmd.move.usage:
Usage: jira move <KEY> <STATUS>
Transition issue status. (e.g. jira move KAN-1 'In Progress')
cmd.move.err_missing_args: Usage: jira move <KEY> <STATUS> (e.g. jira move KAN-1 'In Progress')
cmd.comment.desc: Add a comment to an issue.
cmd.comment.usage:
Usage: jira comment <KEY> <MESSAGE>
Add a comment to an issue. (e.g. jira comment KAN-1 'Code review completed')
cmd.comment.err_missing_args: Usage: jira comment <KEY> <MESSAGE> (e.g. jira comment KAN-1 'Code review completed')

cmd.report.desc: Generate weekly briefing and project progress summary report.
cmd.report.usage:
Usage: jira report [options]
Generate weekly briefing and project progress summary report.

Options:
cmd.open.desc: Open an issue or project board in the web browser.
cmd.open.usage:
Usage: jira open [KEY] [--browser <cmd>] [--url-only]
Open an issue or project board in the web browser. (alias: browse)

Options:
  --browser string   Custom browser command to execute (e.g. 'google-chrome', 'firefox')
  --url-only         Print the target URL without launching a browser
cmd.open.fallback:
⚠️  Failed to open browser. Please visit the URL below:
%s
cmd.open.flag_url_only: Print the target URL without launching a browser
cmd.init_agent.desc: Initialize AI coding agent (Cursor, Claude Code, Antigravity) rules and SKILL files in current directory.
cmd.init_agent.usage:
Usage: jira init-agent [--type cursor|claude|antigravity|all] [--force|-f]
Generate AI coding agent integration rules and SKILL files.

Options:
  --type string   Agent type to generate (cursor, claude, antigravity, all, default: all)
  --force, -f     Overwrite existing files
cmd.init_agent.flag_type: Agent type to generate (cursor, claude, antigravity, all)
cmd.init_agent.footer: 🎉 AI agent rulesets configured successfully. Agents can now operate Jira CLI seamlessly.
